LOFAR Transients Pipeline

.. image:: https://travis-ci.org/transientskp/tkp.svg?branch=master  :target: https://travis-ci.org/transientskp/tkp

The LOFAR Transients Pipeline (or "TraP") is a Python and SQL based system for detecting and responding to transient and variable sources in a stream of astronomical images. It primarily targets LOFAR data, but is also applicable to a range of other instruments. See the pipeline documentation_ for details including key features_, installation instructions and a usage guide.

An overview of the TraP can be found in the TraP paper_ accompanying release 2.0, and we also have an assigned ASCL ID (http://ascl.net/1412.011). If you make use of TraP in work leading to a publication, we ask that you cite these references.

TraP development is coordinated by The LOFAR Transients Key Science Project_.

Bug tracking and feature requests are handled through the repository issue tracker_. Contributions are welcome.

This is open source software: see `COPYING` for licensing and copyright information.
